lines: Koi yeh kaise bataye ke woh tanha kyun hai?
Woh jo apna tha wohi aur kisi ka kyun hai?
couplets.en: Who can say why he is alone, or why the one who was his now belongs to someone else?

lines: Yahi duniya hai to phir aisi yeh duniya kyun hai?
Yahi hota hai to aakhir yahi hota kyun hai?
couplets.en: If this is the world and this is how things go, why must it always be this way?

lines: Ik zara haath badha de to pakad le daaman,
couplets.en: A little reach would catch the hem and draw me close to his chest.

lines: Itni qurbat hai to phir faasla itna kyun hai?
couplets.en: If my heart can beat so close to his, why is there still so much distance between us?

lines: Dil-e-barbaad se nikla nahin ab tak koi,
Ik lute ghar pe diya karta hai dastak koi.
couplets.en: Someone still dwells in this ruined heart, and someone keeps knocking at its plundered door.

lines: Aas jo toot gayi phir se bandhaata kyun hai?
couplets.en: Why does he make me hope again when that hope has already broken?

lines: Tum masarrat ka kaho ya ise gham ka rishta,
Kehte hain pyaar ka rishta hai.
couplets.en: Call it a bond of joy or sorrow, and people will call it love.

lines: Hai janam ka jo yeh rishta to badalta kyun hai?
couplets.en: If this bond is meant to last a lifetime, why does it change?
